Product Overview:
This men's summer casual two-piece set includes a short-sleeve shirt with a lapel collar and jacquard pattern, paired with matching shorts. The design is simple and fashionable, suitable for young people's daily wear. Made from synthetic fiber blend fabric, it offers a comfortable touch and good breathability, making it an ideal choice for summer outings.
